name: Starlit Atlas Dust
description: A luminous dust used to mark routes through the night sky.
specialEffects: Used in pins, maps, celestial trinkets, and starfinding charms.

steps: Refine raw stock for Starlit Atlas Dust under controlled heat and pressure.
Fold and stabilize the blend until impurities are below forge tolerance.
Cast and cool using Starlit Refinery protocol before storage.
